name: tool-schema-minifier
description: Compress a tool-definition document and report the token difference, after checking that required fields, enums, constraints and approval-governing descriptions survived unchanged.

scripts.lint: node --check src/text.mjs && node --check src/tokens.mjs && node --check src/schema.mjs && node --check src/document.mjs && node --check src/index.mjs && node --check bin/tool-schema-minifier.mjs && node --check test/cli.test.mjs && node --check test/determinism.test.mjs && node --check test/equivalence.test.mjs && node --check test/incompleteness.test.mjs && node --check test/limits.test.mjs && node --check test/minify.test.mjs && node --check test/ordering.test.mjs && node --check test/parse-failure.test.mjs && node --check test/sanitising.test.mjs && node --check test/severity-behaviour.test.mjs && node --check test/text.test.mjs && node --check test/tokens.test.mjs
scripts.example:refusal: node bin/tool-schema-minifier.mjs verify --tools examples/tools.json --candidate examples/compressed-broken.json --human; test $? -eq 1
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run example && npm run example:refusal && npm run pack:check
